criterion_text: After the Stormwood finale the player uses the Home Key; Grandpa names the current five, the starter's status, one bond memory and chapter choices; credits roll once per character.

authority.scope_rule: Each criterion is judged literally; full Visual Bars A/B remain separately OPEN. Reuse relevant passing scoped evidence without recapture.

presentation_scope: Visible homecoming content and credits readability in the retained present-starter fixture at actual 1280x720 Low. Earned Stormwood progression, Home Key use, personal state selection and exactly-once behavior are assessed separately by retained behavioral evidence.
evidence_reused: Prior native-resolution inspection of all 13 original frames by this same reviewer

content_findings.reason: Grandpa individually names Solo1, Solo2, Solo3, Solo4 and Solo5. The five displayed names agree with the shown TEAM 5/5 HUD. This is a visible-content match, not proof of state-selection correctness across save or peer variants.
Grandpa identifies Solo1 as the companion chosen here and says it is still beside the player. This visibly acknowledges a retained starter. No released-starter variant is shown or certified.

Grandpa recalls Solo1 discovering one landmark with the player, providing one named shared-experience memory. The singular '1 landmarks' wording is cosmetic copy polish and does not remove the memory or obstruct readability.

Grandpa acknowledges allowing Veridian, the Abyssal Guardian, Solmane and Stormheart to choose their own roads. These displayed choices are legible and fit the panel. Accept/refuse selection correctness and other choice combinations require separate behavioral evidence.

Credits headings, the displayed four-chapter order and Continue exploring button are legible at native 720p with no visible clipping. One still does not establish rolling, scrolling, controller operation or once-per-character behavior.

behavioral_acceptance.limit: That behavioral evidence was not independently inspected here. No earned Stormwood finale, actual Home Key use, durable personal-state correctness, transaction success or exactly-once credits claim is inferred from these images.

retained_observations: 000-010: bare flat furnishings/floor, opaque window panes, stretched wood texture and limited material depth remain separate presentation work.
000-010: broad bright illumination, granular shading and lost trainer collar highlights remain full-bar follow-up.
011: futuristic credits lettering remains a style-coherence follow-up despite passing legibility.
008: singular landmark wording remains cosmetic copy polish.
full_visual_follow_up.limit: No full Bar A/B certification is issued. These findings do not block the literal visible-content component under the current owner scope rule.

excluded_claims: Full F20#1 behavioral closure from images alone
Other personal choice or roster variants
F20#2 fifth-arch glow, audio or closed-state behavior
Earned campaign, physical device or High/Medium proof
method: Reused the retained native-resolution inspection and contact-sheet review. No recapture, source inspection or implementation narrative. This scope-verdict-f20-1.json is the only written artifact for this review.
